description: Adds or updates who in the parent tenant may sign in to child tenants, and with which roles.

items.description: Who in the parent tenant may sign in to child tenants, and with which roles there. A grant for the same user or role and child tenant is updated.

PrincipalType.description: Whether the grant is for a user or a role of the parent tenant.

Principal.description: The user's name or email, or the role's name. It must exist in the parent tenant.

ChildEntryId.description: The registry entry id of the child tenant. Leave it and ChildSlug out for every child tenant.

ChildSlug.description: The slug of the child tenant, used when its entry id isn't known on the site.

ChildRoles.description: The roles the user or role gets in the child tenant.
